scope: Cached Maven verification components only; not the Gradle distribution, SDK/JDK, source/weights or packaged APK audit.
artifact_hash_reference: Each coordinate plus verification_component_line identifies its existing artifact names and SHA-256 records; those records are not duplicated here.
origin_warning: Repository candidates are configured sources, not observed historical downloads. POM project/SCM URLs are declarations; inherited URLs/tags remain ancestor declarations, without synthesized child paths or immutable-revision claims.
role_rule: Lock-derived precedence: app release runtime; app debug-only runtime; other production-module release/runtime; regular test configurations; compiler/KSP/AGP host configurations; otherwise unknown. Metadata/BOM coordinates in runtime locks are not necessarily shipped code. Verification-only/plugin/parent records without lock-role evidence remain unknown.
legal_warning: All legal_permission values remain unverified. P-02/P-02A authorize bounded acquisition, not redistribution or rights clearance; POM licenses and embedded text are declarations, not a legal grant verified by this task.
text_rule: notices/sha256-<digest>.txt retains exact original bytes; no normalization, trimming or invented text. Names select LICENSE/LICENCE/NOTICE/COPYING (including directory descendants), AL2.0/ASL2.0/LGPL2.1/DEPENDENCIES/about.html. AAR classes.jar and libs/*.jar inspected one nested level; no arbitrary path extraction or code execution.
